name: Swallowed Error / Silent Failure
attack_scenario: an error from a security-relevant operation (signature/permission check, validation, decode) is caught and discarded, so the code proceeds as if it succeeded — the check becomes a no-op an attacker sails past
negative_test_hint: make the guarded check fail (present an "invalid-signature" token) and assert the operation is rejected loudly, not silently swallowed

exemplar.explanation: never swallow an error from a security check; fail closed (reject) rather than proceeding as if it passed
